Allowlist (15): crates/whisper-adapters/src/archive.rs, decoder.rs, journal.rs, lib.rs, queue_store.rs, recovery.rs, worker_ipc.rs; crates/whisper-adapters/tests/durability.rs, import_mp3.rs; crates/whisper-core/src/application.rs, ports.rs; crates/whisper-core/tests/scheduler_contract.rs; crates/whisper-desktop/src/root.rs, ui.rs; crates/whisper-worker-cpu/src/decoder.rs. (All paths above retain their full crate prefixes as in USER_AUTHORIZATION_L02.md.)

Application owns admission, ordering, Traiter/Retirer/Reprendre choices, identity/generation and result admission. ports.rs owns typed queue, durable ACK, restore/remove/resume contracts. Adapters execute FIFO/journal, scan-only recovery, archive preparation/publication; worker_ipc routes execution off UI; CPU worker owns codec and bounded PCM. Root composes and UI presents states. No parallel scheduler. Preserve decode_wav_windows wrapper.

TASK-P02: application/ports, journal/FIFO/recovery, archive/service/root/UI integration and interruption checks. ACK only after sync, stable FIFO, Queued restores AwaitingChoice, Running→Interrupted, no auto-start, removal preserves source, confirmed resume without duplicates, confirmed prefix preserved, Complete last, stale generation rejected, StartLive denied during active import. TASK-P02-MP3 applies Q-07 to archive prep and real CPU worker through TXT/SRT, preserves source SHA, manual language precedence, CPU attestation; unsupported profile/corruption/changed source/cancel/crash visible without false Complete. Q-07 v1 ANSWERED_DETAIL no DESIGN change. Live mono 16kHz CBR target 64kbps is L03 qualification. Existing memory limits and GPU exclusion remain.

L01 completed with verified outputs. Exact preflight must bind D19/P07 and reviews, fifteen-path authorization, active railguard, DETAIL-P01/Q-05/Q-07, Git/drift inventory and CPU environment. Seven-path preflight does not qualify expanded scope; P06 immutable and its review is not P07 review.

Product commands proposed/NOT RUN, PowerShell cwd C:\dev\whisper, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc: cargo test --locked -p whisper-core --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --test scheduler_contract -- --nocapture; same pattern for whisper-adapters test durability and import_mp3. V-SCHEDULER checks FIFO/choices/no spontaneous start; V-DURABLE injects interruption and checks prefix/double scan/source; V-IMPORT-MP3 exercises true worker/model to TXT/SRT; V-UI tests the actual desktop consumer. Process termination does not prove power-failure behavior. No product code or campaigns run by this contribution.

Post-persistence material gaps: (1) P07 01_LOTS retains inherited instruction to change decoder manifests/features, conflicting with fifteen paths and no Cargo changes; features already exist. (2) P07 source index lacks immutable snapshots/hashes for existing code sources used as plan foundations and does not include frozen L01-CLOSURE evidence, despite canonical contract §5. (3) P07 preflight section still normatively points to P06, risking reuse of P06 review/gate. Each correction requires new PLANS identity and review. No independent review verdict.
